]> 22/08/2026 7:13 Saturday sun and soft snow.

Happy Saturday from Perisher! Today's bringing a mix of sun and cloud with a top of 5 degrees. Westerly winds will be strongest in the morning, with gusts of up to 56km/h, easing as the day goes on.

34 lifts are spinning today, with 41 runs groomed and ready. Our team is working hard to keep as much terrain open as possible following the recent weather. Expect some softer snow underfoot on the slopes today!

In between runs, be sure to catch the live music around the resort: Josh Cashman at Blue Cow, Car Kills Kiwi and Vinyl 45 at Jax Bar, and DJ Bolta at Mid-Station.

There are some great savings to be had at Slopestyle and Perisher Sports this weekend too, with up to 50% off selected products while stocks last, so don't miss out!

Keen to keep the good vibes going after the sun goes down? Night Skiing and Boarding is on tonight at Front Valley, 6:00-8:30pm.

Have a great day out there!
